title: Historical CSV Work Item Message
description: Message dispatched by the historical-dispatcher function to the historical-worker queue. Each message represents one CSV file to download and process.

s3_key.description: Full S3 object key for the CSV file

correlation_id.description: UUID correlation ID for distributed tracing

enqueued_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the work item was dispatched

last_modified.description: ISO-8601 S3 LastModified timestamp of the CSV file. Used by the worker to derive year/month (UTC) for the ADLS path raw/pvdaq/site_id={id}/year={y}/month={m}/{file}. Falls back to ingestion date if absent.
